name: clear_field_and_call_vector

name: allocate_block_and_store_link
description: If the input value is non-zero, it calls the exec memory allocation vector through the library base; when that returns a non-null block, it stores the input plus four in the block's first longword. This is arp.library code.

name: return_zero_stub

name: increment_counter_clear_bit

name: decrement_refcount_maybe_release
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter at offset 32. When it reaches zero and bit 3 of the flag byte at offset 14 is set, it calls another routine and returns that result; otherwise it returns zero. The code is in icon.library.

name: unlink_node_or_set_flag
description: If the short at offset 8 is zero, it calls a library vector with a value from offset 42 and removes the structure from a doubly linked list by joining its neighbours. Otherwise it sets bit 3 of the flag byte at offset 14 and returns zero.

name: set_flag_bit_return_zero

name: return_zero_stub

On a null result it raises an exec alert; otherwise it copies the base pointer and result into two global variables.

name: copy_two_longs_to_globals

name: chain_setup_with_cleanup
description: Calls one routine and, if it returns a non-zero value, passes that value to a second routine together with the arguments. If the second call fails, it passes the value to a third routine to release it and returns zero; otherwise it returns the first value.

name: fill_record_from_stack_buffer

name: copy_stack_fields_to_record

name: validate_icon_file_header
description: Reads the icon data through library calls and checks that the first word matches the header constant written by the copy routine and that the second word is one. It then clears two words and processes an optional extra data block when a flag is set. The text .info marks this as Workbench icon file handling.

name: read_icon_header_fields
description: Repeats the header check and reads two values from the input into the record at offsets 18 and 22. It also loops over several optional fields, storing each result as it reads, and falls through to a shared exit when a read fails.

name: read_icon_optional_blocks
description: Reads two values into the record at offsets 18 and 22, then conditionally reads further blocks guarded by the record fields at offsets 50, 54 and 70. It returns one when the reads succeed and zero when any read fails.

name: read_icon_long_array_entries
description: Loops over a longword array, reading one value per entry through a library call and storing it, and decrements a byte counter by four per entry until it reaches four or less. It then reads a value into the record at offset 70 when that field is non-zero, and returns one on success or zero on failure.

name: call_routine_return_zero

name: return_void_stub

name: allocate_icon_buffer_and_read
description: Allocates a 260-byte block through a library call. If that fails it reports an error code through another routine and returns zero; otherwise it copies a longword from the record and calls several routines to read the icon data into the block.

name: read_icon_optional_extras
description: Saves a longword from the record on the stack and performs a sequence of read calls gated by flag bits and a pointer field at offset 66, returning the outcome of the last call. The text .info marks this as Workbench icon file reading.

name: process_icon_pointer_list
description: Calls a routine and two library vectors, then handles the pointer at offset 50 through a library call when it is set. It then walks a null-terminated pointer list at offset 54, calling a routine for each entry, and returns the final status.

name: walk_icon_pointer_list
description: Advances past a null-terminated pointer list and, if a library call succeeds, loops over the list at offset 54 calling a routine and two library vectors for each entry. It returns zero when any step fails.

name: process_pointer_list_entries
description: Loops over a null-terminated pointer list, calling a routine and two library vectors per entry. It then handles the pointer at offset 70 the same way and returns one on success or zero on failure.

name: drain_icon_entry_list
description: Repeatedly calls a routine on the structure at offset 2 from the argument and passes each non-zero result to a second routine, stopping when the first call returns zero.

name: return_void_stub

name: forward_with_offset_140

name: allocate_icon_record_or_free

name: decrement_counter_store_pair
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter through a pointer, then stores two 32-bit values into consecutive slots of a table at the new counter position. It returns one.

name: allocate_icon_node_or_free

name: return_void_stub

name: return_zero_stub

name: check_icon_entry_sizes

name: search_icon_entry_size

name: return_zero_stub

name: divide_unsigned_32bit_loop
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a divisor using a sixteen-step shift-and-subtract loop when the divisor is larger than sixteen bits. A second path handles smaller divisors, and the quotient and remainder are left in registers.

name: restoring_divide_sixteen_steps
description: Runs a sixteen-step restoring division loop that shifts a 32-bit value left one bit at a time and subtracts the divisor whenever it fits. It leaves the quotient and remainder in registers and returns no value.

name: multiply_32bit_partial_products
description: Multiplies two 32-bit register values using 16-bit partial products and combines the cross terms into the high word of the result. It returns the 64-bit pair together with the second operand with its halves swapped.

name: measure_string_length
description: Counts the characters in a zero-terminated string and returns the count. It walks the bytes until the terminator and returns the number of characters before it.

name: find_character_in_string

name: compare_bounded_strings

name: return_one_stub

name: walk_bounded_string_to_end

name: forward_to_handler_routine

name: copy_string_with_padding

name: return_void_stub

name: process_block_with_check

name: walk_block_list_check

name: allocate_chain_of_blocks

description: Opens the dos.library and graphics.library names through the library-open vector at offset minus 552, storing the two library bases in global variables. It initializes a list header in the structure and closes libraries and frees memory when an open fails.

name: unload_unused_segment_entries

name: close_library_and_free_node
description: When a short value at offset 38 is zero and the counter at offset 40 is below one, closes two libraries, unlinks the node from its list and frees the memory it occupies.

name: set_flag_high_bit

name: decrement_counter_and_call

name: return_zero_stub

name: build_font_name_buffer
description: Copies names from a linked list of font entries at offset 140 into a caller buffer, storing each entry's length, flag and pointer fields alongside the name. Its behaviour depends on the flag bits passed in, and it returns a status value.

name: copy_font_entry_names
description: Walks a linked list of font entries, copying each entry's name string into a buffer and recording the entry's size and attribute bytes beside it, until the list ends.

name: fill_font_entry_buffer
description: Copies characters from a source string into a buffer, then walks a linked list of font entries recording each entry's name position and attributes. A second pass runs only when a flag bit is set.

name: scan_fonts_directory_entries
description: When the flag bit is set, it allocates a 260-byte buffer and examines the FONTS: directory. It checks each entry name for a dot before the .font suffix and records the matching font entries.

name: read_font_file_header
description: Reads a four-byte header from the input and checks it against a fixed signature. When it matches, it reads a count and records a block of entries into the buffer while decrementing a remaining-size counter.

name: read_font_entry_blocks
description: Copies a name string into the buffer, reads and checks a header count, then reads 260-byte entry blocks into the output list while the remaining size stays non-negative.

name: read_font_blocks_until_end
description: Reads 260-byte blocks from the input until the list is exhausted, storing each as a record and tracking the remaining size. It releases the buffer afterwards.

name: finish_font_read_status
description: Releases resources through routine calls, then returns the absolute value of the remaining size counter when it is negative, and zero otherwise.

name: return_zero_stub

name: score_font_size_distance

name: score_font_style_bits
description: Compares the style flag bytes of a request and a candidate font, subtracting a weighted table value for each mismatched bit from a size-derived base.

name: score_style_bit_penalty
description: Tests bits from two flag words in turn and subtracts a table value for each mismatch, returning the accumulated penalty.

name: score_style_bits_iterate

name: return_negative_sentinel

name: load_named_font_entries

name: select_best_font_entry

name: mark_best_font_entry_loaded

name: link_loaded_font_entries

name: pick_font_entry_until_done

name: close_font_and_release_entries

name: forward_to_handler_routine
description: Calls another routine unconditionally and returns, with no other work. It is one of the short forwarding entries in diskfont.library's pointer table.

name: stub_no_instructions_decoded
description: The decompiler timed out, and the facts show zero instructions and a program entry. There is no routine body to describe, so no behaviour is claimed.

name: call_routine_then_dos_open
description: Runs a fixed-address routine first, then calls the library function at offset minus 30 through a library base held in a global variable. It was reached during a reference run from outside the static flow.

name: call_library_vector_30
description: Calls the library function at offset minus 30 through a library base held in a global variable, then returns. It was reached during a reference run from outside the static flow.

name: call_library_vector_348
description: Calls the library function at offset minus 348 through a library base held in a global variable, then returns. It was reached during a reference run and is called by one routine.

name: clear_flag_bit_increment_counter
description: Clears the most significant bit of the flag byte at offset 14 and adds one to the 16-bit field at offset 38.

name: program_entry_find_task_open
description: Main program entry. Its listed library calls are exec FindTask, dos CurrentDir and dos Open, plus a library vector at offset minus 294, and it is called once from unnamed code.

name: release_pending_message_ports
description: When a saved value is non-zero, it releases up to two saved handles through the library vector at offset minus 36, then makes exec calls for Forbid, Alert and ReplyMsg. It returns the saved value paired with its argument.

name: call_two_library_vectors
description: Calls two library functions through the library base held in the register, at offsets minus 384 and then minus 372, and returns nothing.

name: open_dos_library_or_release
description: Opens the dos library through the library-open vector at offset minus 552 and returns the library base if it succeeds. On failure it raises an alert and runs the same release sequence as its neighbour before returning.

name: parse_quoted_argument_list
description: Splits a command-line style string into up to thirty-two entries, storing each quoted argument's start pointer in a global table and skipping whitespace between them. The referenced text includes an unterminated-quote error message and a console window specification.

name: link_allocated_block_node
description: Calls a routine with an offset of 12 from its argument. When that returns a non-zero handle, it stores the argument in the handle's link field and calls a library vector at offset minus 198. It returns the handle offset by 12, or zero on failure.

name: return_result_or_minus_one
description: Calls one routine with its argument and returns the result if it is non-zero, otherwise minus one.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Returns minus one immediately with no other work.

name: free_all_list_entries
description: Walks a linked list from a global head, passing each node and its stored size to the library vector at offset minus 210 (FreeMem), until the list ends.

name: append_node_to_list_tail
description: Appends a node to the tail of a list whose header holds head and tail pointers. It links the old tail to the node and sets the head when the list was empty.

name: open_required_system_libraries
description: Opens the diskfont, graphics, icon, intuition and layers libraries by name through a shared open routine. A numbered alert code is raised for each library that fails to open.

name: allocate_fixed_size_buffers
description: Allocates several fixed-size blocks through library calls, including blocks of 400, 880, 200 and 220 bytes, and raises alert code 10 for each allocation that fails.

name: allocate_large_display_buffers
description: Allocates a block of 8000 bytes and a block of 16080 bytes through library calls with a fixed flag, raising alert codes 21 and 31 when they fail. It then computes a pointer inside the second block.

name: load_winter_tile_resources
description: Loads three named resources from the winter directory, Doc.Paper, green.felt and tile2, through a loader routine. It raises alert code 51 on failure and stores each result in a global table.

name: open_title_display_surface
description: Calls a display routine with fixed numeric arguments, and the shanghai.title text is referenced by the call.

name: trace_rectangle_outline_calls
description: Issues five calls that take the four parameters in turn, tracing the corners of a rectangle and closing back at the first corner. It returns nothing.

name: report_open_failure_error
description: Looks up a numeric code in a table and, when it is recognised, reports an error through a formatted message. The referenced text covers failing to open a named file, failing to open a numbered item, and running out of memory.

name: point_inside_rectangle
description: Returns one when the point given by the first two arguments lies inside the four-value bounds structure, including its edges, and zero otherwise.

name: compute_bit_masks_once
description: On first use it calls a routine with a fixed value and sets a flag. It then builds two single-bit masks from byte fields in two structures, calls a library vector at offset minus 318 and a further routine, and returns an integer. The decompiled body continues beyond the part shown, so the rest is not described.
